description: JSON Schema + MCP ToolAnnotations for every LLM/agent tool (src/tools/*.tools.ts via createFuturesToolkit()). Scope: tool inputs only, not a response schema per registry endpoint -- see this file's generator script header for why that's a separate, harder problem. inputSchema is generated directly from each tool's own Zod schema (zero hand-curation); annotations are hand-classified per tool in src/tools/annotations.ts (readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint) and attached before this script runs, so this file and the live MCP server can never disagree.

tools.name: futures_ping
tools.description: Test connectivity to the Binance USD-M futures REST API. Returns empty object {} on success.

tools.name: futures_server_time
tools.description: Get the current Binance USD-M futures server time in milliseconds since epoch.

tools.name: futures_exchange_info

tools.name: futures_ticker_price

tools.name: futures_ticker_price_v2

tools.name: futures_book_ticker_v2

tools.name: futures_trading_day_ticker

tools.name: futures_insurance_balance

tools.name: futures_index_price_constituents

tools.name: futures_account_v2

tools.name: futures_trade_download_status

tools.name: futures_account_config

tools.name: futures_income_download_status

tools.name: futures_new_order
tools.description: Place a new futures order. Types: LIMIT, MARKET, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET. Use STOP_MARKET as the take-profit/stop-loss trigger and LIMIT for the actual fill. Signed.

price.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP/TAKE_PROFIT (limit-triggered) types

reduceOnly.description: true = only reduces the position, never opens

closePosition.description: Close the full position on trigger (mutually exclusive with quantity)

goodTillDate.description: Timestamp when a GTD order expires

tools.name: futures_test_order
tools.description: Validate a new order without submitting it. Returns 200 on success; use to validate fields and margin before real orders. Signed.

price.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP/TAKE_PROFIT (limit-triggered) types

reduceOnly.description: true = only reduces the position, never opens

closePosition.description: Close the full position on trigger (mutually exclusive with quantity)

goodTillDate.description: Timestamp when a GTD order expires

goodTillDate.description: Timestamp when a GTD order expires

tools.description: Query an algo order by algoId or clientAlgoId. Signed.

tools.name: futures_all_algo_orders

tools.name: futures_convert_get_quote
tools.description: Request a Convert quote between two assets (quote expires quickly; accept with futures_convert_accept_quote). Signed.

quantity.description: Base-asset quantity; omit if using quoteOrderQty

quoteOrderQty.description: Quote-asset quantity (e.g. spend 100 USDT on a MARKET order)

stopPrice.description: Trigger price for STOP_LOSS / TAKE_PROFIT variants

tools.description: Query a specific Spot order by orderId or client order id. Signed.

tools.name: spot_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a specific open Spot order by orderId or client order id. Signed.

tools.name: spot_open_orders

tools.name: spot_ws_start_user_stream
tools.description: Start the Spot user data stream: creates a listenKey, connects the private WebSocket, and begins keep-alive. Emits executionReport, outboundAccountPosition, balanceUpdate, listStatus.

tools.name: spot_ws_stop_user_stream
tools.description: Stop the Spot user data stream: closes the private WebSocket and invalidates the listenKey.

tools.name: futures_symbol_rules
tools.description: Get the tradeable rules for a symbol in one call: tick size, step size, min/max quantity, market-order lot bounds and minimum notional, flattened out of exchangeInfo filters. Call this before sizing or pricing any order.

tools.name: futures_quantize
tools.description: Round a price to the symbol's tick size and a quantity to its step size, returning exchange-ready strings. Use this instead of rounding numbers yourself — Binance rejects off-tick prices (-1111).

marketOrder.description: Use MARKET_LOT_SIZE bounds instead of LOT_SIZE

tools.name: futures_size_position
tools.description: Convert a risk budget into an exchange-ready order quantity. Given a stop price and either riskAmount (quote currency) or riskPct (percent of available balance), returns the quantity rounded down to the symbol step size, plus the notional, required margin and every constraint that failed (min notional, lot bounds, wrong-side stop). Never increases risk to satisfy a minimum — it reports instead.

riskAmount.description: Quote-currency amount to risk, e.g. 50 USDT

riskPct.description: Percent of available balance to risk (signed call)

tools.name: futures_close_position
tools.description: Flatten an open position with a reduce-only market order. Reads the current position, derives the closing side from its sign, and automatically uses reduceOnly in one-way mode vs positionSide in hedge mode (Binance rejects the wrong one). Set dryRun to preview the order without sending it. Signed, destructive.

positionSide.description: Required when hedge mode has both sides open

portion.description: Fraction of the position to close, e.g. 0.5 for half

tools.name: futures_market_snapshot
tools.description: One-call market picture for a symbol: 24h stats, mark/index price with funding, open interest and long/short positioning. Replaces four separate primitive calls; individual feeds degrade to an error field rather than failing the whole snapshot.

tools.name: futures_account_overview
tools.description: One-call account picture: funded balances, open positions only (zero-size entries filtered out), working orders, and totals for unrealized PnL and gross notional. Signed.

tools.name: futures_place_bracket_order
tools.description: Place an entry order together with its protective stop-loss and optional take-profit, with all prices quantized to the symbol tick. Returns each leg separately; if a protective leg fails the response is flagged protectionComplete=false and the entry is NOT auto-cancelled (it may already have filled). Signed, destructive.

tools.name: execution_place_order
tools.description: Place an order through the execution gateway: idempotent (retry with the same intentId returns the original execution), reconciled on ambiguous failures, and routable to the live exchange or the paper simulator via `backend`. Paper orders need no API keys. MARKET and LIMIT types supported on paper.

price.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP/TAKE_PROFIT (limit-triggered) types

reduceOnly.description: true = only reduces the position, never opens

closePosition.description: Close the full position on trigger (mutually exclusive with quantity)

goodTillDate.description: Timestamp when a GTD order expires

intentId.description: Idempotency key. Re-submitting the same intentId returns the original execution instead of placing a second order. Recommended for any retry loop.

backend.description: Execution backend for this call; default is the gateway's default backend

tools.name: execution_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order idempotently by exchange orderId, clientOrderId, or the intentId from execution_place_order. Cancels of already-gone orders resolve to a terminal CANCELED execution (never a thrown -2011).

intentId.description: Idempotency key. Re-submitting the same intentId returns the original execution instead of placing a second order. Recommended for any retry loop.

backend.description: Execution backend for this call; default is the gateway's default backend

tools.name: execution_get_order
tools.description: Fetch an execution from the ledger by its intentId. When `backend` is omitted both ledgers are searched (paper first), so callers do not need to remember where an intent ran.

backend.description: Execution backend for this call; default is the gateway's default backend

tools.name: execution_list_orders
tools.description: List the execution ledger (most recent first) for a backend. Each entry carries status, fills, and reconciliation state. Paper and live ledgers are independent.

backend.description: Execution backend for this call; default is the gateway's default backend

tools.name: execution_reconcile_order
tools.description: Force a reconciliation pass for an intent whose outcome is unknown (e.g. after a timeout). Recovers the true state from the exchange (live) or simulator (paper) instead of guessing.

backend.description: Execution backend for this call; default is the gateway's default backend

tools.name: execution_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the execution environment: default backend, risk-gateway state (when a trading policy is configured), and the paper simulator account (balance, positions, unrealized PnL). Read-only, never places orders.

tools.name: futures_ws_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to real-time market data streams. Topic format: <symbol>@<stream>, e.g. btcusdt@aggTrade, btcusdt@kline_1m, btcusdt@depth20, btcusdt@markPrice@1s, btcusdt@bookTicker, btcusdt@ticker, btcusdt@miniTicker, btcusdt@forceOrder, or all-market topics !ticker@arr, !bookTicker, !markPrice@arr, !forceOrder@arr, !miniTicker@arr. Multiple topics can be passed at once.

tools.name: futures_ws_unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe from previously subscribed market data streams.

tools.name: futures_ws_subscriptions
tools.description: List the currently subscribed WebSocket market streams for this client.

tools.name: futures_ws_events
tools.description: Read the buffered real-time payloads received since the last read for the subscribed streams (aggregate trades, klines, depth deltas, mark price, book tickers, tickers, force orders). Payloads are parsed; depth deltas must be applied to a snapshot from futures_order_book.

tools.name: futures_ws_clear_events
tools.description: Clear the buffered WebSocket events so the next read only returns new payloads.

tools.name: futures_ws_start_user_stream
tools.description: Start the user data stream: creates a listenKey, connects the private WebSocket, and begins a 30-minute keep-alive. Emits private events (ACCOUNT_UPDATE, ORDER_TRADE_UPDATE, MARGIN_CALL, ACCOUNT_CONFIG_UPDATE, listenKeyExpired) that the application can consume from the client.

tools.name: futures_ws_stop_user_stream
tools.description: Stop the user data stream: closes the private WebSocket and invalidates the listenKey.

tools.name: futures_ws_api_order_status
tools.description: Query an order via the signed WebSocket API (order.status) — lower-latency alternative to futures_get_order.

tools.name: futures_ws_api_account_status
tools.description: Get account info via the signed WebSocket API (account.status).

tools.name: futures_ws_api_account_position
tools.description: Get current positions via the signed WebSocket API (account.position).

tools.name: futures_ws_api_user_data_stream_start
tools.description: Create a listenKey via the signed WebSocket API (userDataStream.start) — no REST call required.

tools.name: futures_ws_api_user_data_stream_stop
tools.description: Invalidate a listenKey via the signed WebSocket API (userDataStream.stop).

tools.name: futures_ws_api_ticker_price
tools.description: Get latest price via the unsigned WebSocket API (ticker.price); omit symbol for all symbols.

tools.name: futures_ws_api_order_book
tools.description: Get order-book depth via the unsigned WebSocket API (depth).

tools.name: paper_init
tools.description: Initialize paper-trading state (reset balances, positions, history). No API keys required.

tools.name: paper_balance
tools.description: Get current paper-trading balance and open-position equity (uses live market prices if an open position exists). No API keys required.

tools.name: paper_open_position
tools.description: Open an in-memory paper position at the live ticker price (or a fixed price). No API keys required.

price.description: If omitted, uses live ticker price

tools.name: paper_close_position
tools.description: Close a paper position by id (or symbol) and realize PnL at the live/last price.

symbol.description: Close the position for this symbol

price.description: If omitted, uses live ticker price

tools.name: paper_positions
tools.description: List open paper positions with live unrealized PnL (marked to market).

tools.name: paper_history
tools.description: List paper-trading history of open/close events with realized PnL.

tools.name: paper_summary
tools.description: Summarize paper-trading state: balance, open positions, trade count.
